title: Annotatio VI §.V (1): Impious lack supernatural spirituality; flesh vivifies (Jn 6)
pass_a_gloss: But the Impious possess nothing of supernatural Spirituality by which they could grasp spiritual things. Moreover food of this spiritual kind is such that with it all spiritual goods cohere — for Christ’s flesh assumed vivifies, and gives life to the world eating (Jn 6), and so much the more as the abstract Communication of divine idioms presses that more tightly.
pass_b_english: The Impious have no supernatural spirituality by which to grasp spiritual things.
This food coheres with all spiritual goods: assumed flesh vivifies and gives life to the world that eats (Jn 6) — pressed harder still by communication of divine idioms.
source_text: Sed Impii nihil Spiritualitatis supernaturalis possident, quô spiritualia capere possent. Præterea est cibus hujusmodi spiritualis, ut cum eo omnia bona spiritualia cohæreant, caro enim Christi assumta vivificat, & mundo manducanti dat vitam Joh. 6. tantóque magis, quanto idiomatum divinorum Communicatio abstracta id urget pressius.
